faqs.question: What does managed hosting and security actually cover?
faqs.answer: We host your website on fast, monitored infrastructure and handle the technical side: SSL/HTTPS, a firewall, malware scanning, automated backups, software and server updates, and uptime monitoring. If something goes wrong, we are the team that fixes it — you do not have to chase a hosting helpdesk.

faqs.question: Do I own the hosting and domain, or are they locked to you?
faqs.answer: You own them, fully. Hosting, domain, SSL, and email are set up in accounts registered in your name, and you keep the logins. There is no lock-in — if you ever move on, everything goes with you, and we will help with a clean migration.

faqs.question: What happens if my website gets hacked or goes down?
faqs.answer: Because we monitor uptime and keep regular off-site backups, we can usually catch issues quickly and restore your site to a clean, working version. We then close the gap that caused it — whether that is an outdated plugin, a weak password, or a missing firewall rule — so it does not happen again.

faqs.question: Can you take over hosting for a site you didn't build?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can migrate an existing website onto our managed hosting with little or no downtime, then secure and monitor it the same way. We will review your current setup first, in a free consultation, and tell you honestly what needs attention before anything moves.

faqs.question: How is this different from website maintenance?
faqs.answer: Maintenance is about your content and features — edits, new pages, and design tweaks. Hosting and security is about where the site lives and how it is protected: server performance, uptime, SSL, the firewall, and backups. Many clients take both, and they work well together.
